name: Special Workspaces
description: Requires drpezzer.roadie for full effect. A single hidden group of special workspaces (slot 1, 2, 3...) with its own configurable toggle keybind, navigable with SUPER+Z/X, scroll, or clicking the bar exactly like regular workspaces. Dock auto-hide/fullscreen awareness is provided by drpezzer.roadie directly. Pairs with positive.workspace-app-indicator for the focused-app badge.
author: POSiTiiiV
permissions: Reads /tmp/ambxst_special_ws.txt to track the active isolated special workspace
Renders special-group slots on the workspace bar using the same numbering/occupancy display as regular workspaces, plus a dimmed highlight marker
Runs ~/.config/hypr/scripts/special-workspace-nav.sh (installed separately, see README) to switch slots when scrolling or clicking the bar while in the special group
Runs 'hyprctl reload' when this mod's keybind/slot-count/animation settings change
